svg.title: ECERC-Revisited merged architecture
svg.desc: Merged ECERC-Revisited model. Text, audio, visual, semantic features and speaker IDs pass through Evidence Gating, cause encoders, four cross-attentions and Feature Gating, then the CACG cause gate and a classifier. Per-seed logits are ensembled; MELD also fuses cached LLM scores; temperature scaling calibrates the output.
svg.text: Speaker masks: which past turns each cause may attend to
w and T are set on validation only
÷ T per seed, softmax, then mean
KL(q ‖ g) with 4 auxiliary cause classifiers
Tested, not in the final model
Cost about 0.5 wF1 on top of WavLM
MELD's audio and visual slots are swapped in the release and kept for checkpoint compatibility. ECE in %, after temperature scaling.
